{{Top|leg}}
A '''credit account''' was a financial account that held its user's [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Credits could be transferred between credit accounts via [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|subspace transceivers]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] retailer [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]] accepted payment via credit account transfer for merchandise sold via it's [[Datalog/Legends|datalog]], ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]''.
